en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, form his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Refused except that He<sup>azwj</sup> would Make the livelihoods of the Believers from where they did not reckon’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ayyub af-Khazzaz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, disdains to provide sustenance for a believing person from any source other than an unexpected source.”
